description:
We are a team of NYU Center for Urban Science and Progress (CUSP) graduate students in NYC (EST), united by skills in Spatial Data Science, GIS, and Machine Learning.

We are tackling "Identify Earth Locations that Analog the Permanent Moon Base." Approaching a lunar base as extreme-environment infrastructure planning, we are building a NASA Remote Sensing Spatial Similarity Engine.
summary: An interactive StoryMap that helps scientists identify Earth sites analogous to lunar magmatic water environments through customizable criteria and mapping. The project is primarily designed for aeronautic researchers, astrogeographers, and astrobiologists. It provides a customization tool to compare moon and earth geology, and at the same time, searches for an analog earth site to a specific moon site.
details: Lunar water, despite its polar ice form, also exists in minerals generated by early lunar magma outgassing and volcanic eruptions. The project investigates whether these hydroxyl and water (OH⁻ and H₂O) in lunar volcanic materials and minerals could exist on Earth. The final deliverable will be an interactive scientific product that allows NASA scientists, astrogeographers, and astrobiology research communities to identify new research sites by adjusting weights and layers of each indicator. Its value lies in reducing initial site-selection workload, making the investigation more targeted, connecting lunar questions to terrestrial research opportunities, finding analog sites for different purposes, and communicating visually with researchers. Through the StoryMap platform, users could explore the Moon map, select a lunar reference site, customize Earth research criteria (formation similarity and water retention potential), run Moon-to-Earth matching across the United States, generate top Earth analog sites, and compare their geological features and supporting datasets. Finally, the project integrated the Gemini API into the website, allowing users to understand the final comparison results and scientific knowledge.
